verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's own feature page says it can create and send customizable email campaigns with pro templates. That covers templated email sends from inside the product, but the only evidence is a single marketing line. Workflow automation mentions flows and triggered events, but nothing ties these to multi-step email sequences to prospects. Missing for 10: documented multi-step or drip email sequences, per-prospect templated sending from deal or contact records, detailed docs on templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send templated emails or multi-step sequences to prospects from inside the CRM

citations.quote: Create and send customizable email campaigns with pro templates, built to get more clicks
